text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With her front-running pushed to the 
ultimate limit, Twin Turbo conquers the 
Tanabata Sho, becoming a beacon of hope 
for everyone.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so, her next goal was decided to be 
the All Comers. She even posted a letter 
of challenge on the door to Tokai Teio's 
room.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
However, around that time, Tokai Teio... 
was crushed by the reality that her leg 
wasn't recovering and she couldn't run as 
she wished.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Unaware of what lay ahead, Twin Turbo 
began special training for the All Comers, 
where powerhouses like Ikuno Dictus 
awaited.
